dataset_title: Godavari Pushkaralu 2027 — Pilgrim Location Evidence Registry
important_note: Research registry, not a live operational feed. Planned works, reported works, transport options, facility availability, and contacts must be rechecked against current official notices before being presented as confirmed.

status_definitions.official_fact: A government or official tourism page supports the stated general fact.
status_definitions.official_notice_published: An official notice exists; it does not prove the work is complete.
status_definitions.reported_preparation: A news report describes planned or ongoing works; verify with a later official update.
status_definitions.listed_not_availability_guaranteed: An official portal lists a service/property, but current availability or event-period pricing is not guaranteed.
status_definitions.needs_verification: The current event-specific detail could not be confirmed from the sources reviewed.

languages.en: Basara is a major temple destination associated with Sri Gnana Saraswathi Temple on the Godavari. Event-specific ghat access and facilities need current confirmation.
languages.te: బాసర గోదావరి తీరంలోని శ్రీ జ్ఞాన సరస్వతి ఆలయానికి ప్రసిద్ధి చెందిన పుణ్యక్షేత్రం. పుష్కరాల ఘాట్ ప్రవేశం మరియు ప్రత్యేక సదుపాయాలను తాజా అధికారిక సమాచారంతో నిర్ధారించాలి.
languages.hi: बासर गोदावरी के किनारे स्थित श्री ज्ञान सरस्वती मंदिर के लिए प्रसिद्ध तीर्थस्थल है। पुष्करालु के दौरान घाट तक पहुँच और विशेष सुविधाओं की वर्तमान आधिकारिक पुष्टि आवश्यक है.

records.fact: The district portal lists Sri Gnana Saraswathi Devasthanam at Basara as a temple/tourist destination.
General access information is available on the district page; the best current train-and-road combination and event-period bus schedules must be checked before publication.
Check the official tourism hotel directory for Basara listings; room availability and Pushkaralu-period pricing are not guaranteed.
Pushkaralu-specific bathing access, toilets, drinking water, changing rooms, medical posts, parking and accessibility arrangements have not been confirmed in this registry.
Use the statewide emergency directory and confirm local police/medical facilities before displaying location-specific details.

languages.en: Dharmapuri is a Godavari pilgrimage location. A preliminary land-acquisition notice covers two roads linked to Pushkaralu 2027; completion and ghat access must be verified.
languages.te: ధర్మపురి గోదావరి తీర్థయాత్ర ప్రాంతం. పుష్కరాలు 2027కు సంబంధించిన రెండు రహదారుల భూసేకరణపై ప్రాథమిక నోటిఫికేషన్ ఉంది; పనుల పూర్తిస్థాయి మరియు ఘాట్ ప్రవేశాన్ని నిర్ధారించాలి.
languages.hi: धर्मपुरी गोदावरी का तीर्थस्थल है। पुष्करालु 2027 से जुड़ी दो सड़कों के लिए प्रारंभिक भूमि-अधिग्रहण अधिसूचना है; कार्य पूरा होने और घाट तक पहुँच की पुष्टि आवश्यक है.

records.fact: Dharmapuri is associated with Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple and a Godavari bathing location.
A preliminary land-acquisition notification for two separate roads in Dharmapuri Municipality linked to Godavari Pushkaralu 2027 is listed with start date 2026-09-30 and end date 2026-11-28.
A news report dated 2026-10-24 reports planned 470-metre ghats and preparation of roads, changing rooms, drinking water, sanitation, electricity, medical services and parking.
Check TGSRTC and district road notices for current routes, diversions, parking and event-period special services.
Use the official tourism hotel directory and district announcements; a dedicated event-period room allocation has not been verified.
Use statewide emergency numbers and check the police directory for current Jagtial district contacts.

languages.en: Kotilingala is a Godavari-bank temple destination. A 210-metre ghat project has been reported; completion and public access are not confirmed.
languages.te: కోటిలింగాల గోదావరి తీరంలోని ఆలయ ప్రాంతం. 210 మీటర్ల ఘాట్ పనుల గురించి వార్తా నివేదిక ఉంది; పనుల పూర్తిస్థాయి మరియు ప్రజల ప్రవేశం నిర్ధారించబడలేదు.
languages.hi: कोटिलिंगाला गोदावरी तट का मंदिर स्थल है। 210 मीटर के घाट की परियोजना की खबर प्रकाशित हुई है; निर्माण पूरा होने और सार्वजनिक पहुँच की पुष्टि नहीं है.

records.fact: The Jagtial district portal identifies Sri Koteshwara Swamy Temple at Kotilingala, Velgatur mandal, on the Godavari riverbank.
A news report dated 2026-10-24 describes a planned 210-metre ghat at Kotilingala.
Use official TGSRTC information and current district road notices; no confirmed special Pushkaralu bus timetable is recorded here.
Toilets, drinking water, changing rooms, medical posts, parking, accessibility and crowd controls require current official confirmation.
Check official tourism listings and district notices; event-period room availability has not been confirmed.
Use statewide emergency numbers and confirm local police/medical posts before travel.

languages.en: Manthani is a reported focus of Pushkaralu preparation. A 180-metre ghat and road/facility improvements have been reported as planned or underway; completion is unverified.
languages.te: మంథని పుష్కరాల ఏర్పాట్లలో ముఖ్యమైన ప్రాంతంగా నివేదించబడింది. 180 మీటర్ల ఘాట్, రహదారులు మరియు ఇతర సదుపాయాల పనులు ప్రణాళికలో ఉన్నట్లు/జరుగుతున్నట్లు వార్తలు తెలిపాయి; పూర్తిస్థాయి నిర్ధారించబడలేదు.
languages.hi: मंथनी पुष्करालु की तैयारियों का एक प्रमुख स्थान बताया गया है। 180 मीटर घाट और सड़क/सुविधा सुधारों की योजना या काम की खबर है; पूरा होना सत्यापित नहीं है.

records.fact: A news report dated 2026-10-24 describes plans for a 180-metre bathing ghat at Manthani.
The report describes road work between Manthani bus depot and the riverbank, plus a road towards Ramagundam Road; current route conditions and diversions must be checked.
Changing rooms, drinking water, sanitation, medical services, parking and crowd management were described as planned facilities; current availability is not confirmed.
No dedicated Pushkaralu-period accommodation inventory was confirmed in the reviewed sources.
Use statewide emergency numbers and verify local Peddapalli district police and medical facilities.

languages.en: Kaleshwaram is a Telangana Tourism destination associated with the Godavari–Pranahita confluence. Pushkaralu-specific bathing access and services need verification.
languages.te: కాళేశ్వరం గోదావరి–ప్రాణహిత సంగమానికి సంబంధించిన తెలంగాణ పర్యాటక ప్రాంతం. పుష్కరాల ప్రత్యేక ఘాట్ ప్రవేశం మరియు సేవలను నిర్ధారించాలి.
languages.hi: कालेश्वरम गोदावरी–प्राणहिता संगम से जुड़ा तेलंगाना पर्यटन स्थल है। पुष्करालु के लिए विशेष घाट पहुँच और सेवाओं की पुष्टि आवश्यक है.

records.fact: Telangana Tourism lists Kaleshwaram as a destination.
Check current TGSRTC schedules and local district road notices; no confirmed event-period special timetable is recorded here.
Approved bathing areas, river-level restrictions, medical posts, toilets, drinking water, parking and accessibility require event-specific official confirmation.
Check the official tourism hotel directory for a Kaleshwaram listing; availability and event-period pricing are not guaranteed.
Use statewide emergency contacts and verify local Jayashankar Bhupalpally district contacts.

languages.en: Bhadrachalam is a Godavari riverbank pilgrimage town. Reports describe phased ghat and related infrastructure preparation; completion and access must be checked.
languages.te: భద్రాచలం గోదావరి తీరంలోని పుణ్యక్షేత్ర పట్టణం. ఘాట్ మరియు అనుబంధ మౌలిక సదుపాయాల పనులు దశలవారీగా జరుగుతున్నట్లు నివేదికలు ఉన్నాయి; పూర్తిస్థాయి మరియు ప్రవేశాన్ని నిర్ధారించాలి.
languages.hi: भद्राचलम गोदावरी तट का तीर्थ नगर है। घाट और संबंधित बुनियादी ढाँचे के चरणबद्ध कार्यों की खबर है; पूरा होना और पहुँच सत्यापित करें.

records.fact: Bhadrachalam is a Godavari riverbank town associated with Sri Sita Ramachandra Swamy Temple.
A report published 2026-08-30 described earthwork and ₹49 crore sanctioned for ghats and related infrastructure; this does not prove completion.
Road and ghat access works have been reported; current road status, diversions, parking and special transport schedules require a later official update.
Toilets, drinking water, sanitation, medical services, parking, accessibility and crowd controls need current event-specific confirmation.
Telangana Tourism lists Haritha Hotel Bhadrachalam; verify booking availability, current rates and contact details directly.
Use statewide emergency numbers and confirm local Bhadradri Kothagudem district police and medical contacts.

languages.en: Parnasala is included in reported Pushkaralu infrastructure preparation around Bhadrachalam. Ghat renovation and event-period access require confirmation.
languages.te: పర్ణశాల భద్రాచలం పరిసర పుష్కరాల మౌలిక సదుపాయాల ఏర్పాట్లలో ప్రస్తావించబడింది. ఘాట్ మరమ్మతులు మరియు పుష్కరాల సమయంలో ప్రవేశాన్ని నిర్ధారించాలి.
languages.hi: पर्णशाला को भद्राचलम क्षेत्र की पुष्करालु तैयारियों में शामिल बताया गया है। घाट नवीनीकरण और आयोजन के दौरान पहुँच की पुष्टि आवश्यक है.

records.fact: Parnasala is included in reported Bhadrachalam-area Pushkaralu preparation; event-specific ghat access is not confirmed in this registry.
Current bus routes, road conditions, diversions and parking must be checked with district notices and TGSRTC.
Toilets, drinking water, changing areas, medical support, accessibility and crowd-management arrangements need current official confirmation.
Check official tourism listings and confirm onward travel; event-period accommodation availability is not established here.
Use statewide emergency contacts and verify local district police and medical facilities.
